sections.h2: Rosemont Forest Home Prices and Market Pace
sections.html:
In the 24 months from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026, 161 residential sales closed in Rosemont Forest (Virginia Beach, VA) according to REIN MLS records. The median sold price was $340,000, close to the citywide median of $405,000, and homes took a median of 12 days to sell, about the same pace as the citywide median of 15 days. These figures come from closed sales, which show what homes actually sold for rather than asking prices.

The middle half of Rosemont Forest sales closed between $285,000 and $385,000, or about $239 per square foot against $240 citywide. Split by year, the median sold price in the most recent 12 months ($350,000, 65 sales) was about 6% higher than in the earlier 12 months ($330,000, 96 sales). The typical home sold right at its list price (median sale-to-list ratio of 100%).

Recent Rosemont Forest sales were in ZIP code 23464.

sections.h2: What Stands Out About Rosemont Forest
sections.html: 21% of Rosemont Forest sales had four or more bedrooms, against 40% citywide. The median Rosemont Forest home is about 1,360 square feet, smaller than the 1,706 square foot citywide median. 48% of Rosemont Forest homes sold for more than their list price, versus 36% citywide, so competing offers were more common than in the typical neighborhood.

sections.h2: When Rosemont Forest Homes Sell and How Far Prices Range
sections.html:
Closings in Rosemont Forest were busiest in October (17 sales across the two years) and slowest in January (8 sales). Sold prices ran from $180,000 to $459,000, a spread of 2.5x between the lowest and highest sale. 80% of homes closed at or above list price and 4% closed at least 5% below it.

sections.h2: What Kinds of Homes Sell in Rosemont Forest
sections.html:
59% of the sales were detached homes and 41% were attached homes (townhomes or condos). The median home was about 1,360 square feet, with the middle half of sales running from roughly 1,212 to 1,572 square feet. 65% of the homes that sold had 3 bedrooms.

Most homes that sold were built between 1981 and 1986, with a median year built of 1985, so this is mostly homes from the 1970s through the 1990s.
